title: Which of a primary health network's twelve local government areas qualify for its 2028 to 2030 late-life frailty program, the areas whose residents reaching 85 could expect fewer than seven more years under the area's 2024 to 2026 death rates, each age's population inside the published 85-and-over estimate rebuilt from the 2021 census followed forward with each birth window's deaths; with the after-hours service's 2026 visits to residents aged 85 and over and the residents they reached
subdomain: fertility-mortality-life-table-estimation (period life expectancy at 85 by local government area on a single-year life table to 95 and over, each age's population inside the published 85-and-over estimate rebuilt from the census and the deaths since)
prompt_shape: scorecard against a threshold: each of twelve areas' life expectancy at 85 against the seven-year line and whether it qualifies, beside each area's after-hours visits to residents aged 85 and over in 2026 and the residents they reached, and a chart
